title: Quotient and remainder at a boundary
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $i$, if $i$ divided by $n$ has remainder satisfying $i\bmod n+1=n$, then $(i+1)/n=i/n+1$ and $(i+1)\bmod n=0$.
